answer: Bind each agent to one hardware enclave: the chip creates its key inside silicon and publishes an attestation, and the registry accepts only one identity per chip serial. A falcon-fast check rejects a second registration from the same chip, so identities cannot wander between devices. Forging 200 agents needs 200 chips at $45 each, $9,000 in hardware, and reuse revokes both accounts at the zenith of trust.
